protocol: strict relation-specific direction-aware ATT&CK meta-path audit
purpose: Validate path query eligibility before any path-aware training; no model training is performed.
context: Only the target graph TRAIN triples are used as path context for VALID and TEST queries.
path_direction: Every template follows the directed source STIX relation sequence; inverse traversal is only allowed if a template explicitly includes ^-1.
important_limit: These templates are hand-specified structural hypotheses, not proof of causal attack progression. They must be reviewed against ATT&CK/STIX semantics before confirmatory claims.

uses.name: actor_attributed_to_group_uses_technique
uses.rationale: A malware object is attributed to a group that uses the candidate technique.

uses.name: actor_uses_subtechnique_parent
uses.rationale: The actor uses a known sub-technique whose parent is the candidate technique.

mitigates.name: mitigates_child_parent_technique
mitigates.rationale: The mitigation is linked to a child technique of the candidate parent technique.

targets.name: child_technique_parent_targets_asset
targets.rationale: The parent technique of a sub-technique targets the candidate asset type.

subtechnique-of.name: transitive_subtechnique_hierarchy
subtechnique-of.rationale: A two-edge sub-technique hierarchy implies a transitive ancestor candidate.
